links.comparator_used: Baseline models trained without bias mitigation (no fairness-specific objectives), using the same four algorithms on ADNI data
links.outcome: Sex-related bias (disparate impact) and classification performance (balanced accuracy) in AD classification
links.effect: Disparate impact decreased from 1.167 to 0.823; adversarial debiasing achieved the highest balanced accuracy (88.91%); LR/DIR improved performance while maintaining fairness
links.quote: These findings demonstrate that fairness-aware ML can reduce sex-related bias in AD classification without loss of performance and improve interpretability through more balanced representation of disease determinants.
